allies.rationale_text: Decision-trees strengthens multi-criteria-decision-analysis by making branches, outcomes, and trade-offs explicit before scoring.
allies.source_quote: MCDA can be visualized as a decision tree
allies.affinity_rationale: Decision trees provide structured analytical frameworks for MCDA — hypothesis-driven problem solving 'ensures that analysis will unambiguously resolve an issue' through defined criteria.
allies.activation_condition: When multi-criteria evaluation needs structured branching frameworks to organize alternatives and criteria rather than holistic intuitive comparison

allies.rationale_text: Opportunity-cost sharpens multi-criteria-decision-analysis by keeping trade-offs visible instead of pretending all criteria can be maximized together.
allies.source_quote: compare options transparently across competing goals
allies.affinity_rationale: MCDA inherently involves comparing alternatives against multiple criteria — opportunity cost analysis is implicit in every multi-criteria comparison since choosing one option means forgoing others.
allies.activation_condition: When evaluating options requires explicit accounting of what is sacrificed by each choice rather than evaluating alternatives in isolation against absolute criteria

antagonists.rationale_text: Commitment-bias distorts multi-criteria-decision-analysis when the matrix is reverse-engineered to defend a preferred option.
antagonists.source_quote: criteria are subconsciously chosen or weighted to steer toward a desired conclusion
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Scoring weights get 'frozen around an already favored option' — commitment bias corrupts the mechanism that makes MCDA useful by steering criteria toward predetermined conclusions.
antagonists.activation_condition: When prior commitment to a preferred option causes criteria weights to be unconsciously manipulated to confirm the pre-existing preference rather than genuinely evaluating alternatives

structured_tensions.tension_text: Multi-criteria-decision-analysis conflicts with commitment-bias when scoring weights are frozen around an already favored option.
structured_tensions.source_quote: multi-criteria-decision-analysis vs commitment-bias: scoring weights are frozen around an already favored option.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Multi-criteria-decision-analysis conflicts with representativeness-heuristic when salient criteria overshadow base-rate relevance.
structured_tensions.source_quote: multi-criteria-decision-analysis vs representativeness-heuristic: salient criteria overshadow base-rate relevance.
